lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular maxima arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. In the mid-flank region, these maxima are larger and more widely spaced in a grid-like configuration.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the circular blobs to create a nodal grid pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal edge and lower intensity on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin is visible in the lower center, featuring a distinct distribution of smaller, densely packed high-luminance spots.
